title: Nutmegy Molten Brazil Meal-Prep Tart
description: A tangy and creamy Brazilian-style tart, perfect for meal prep, featuring a nutmeg-infused filling and a crunchy coconut crust.
instructions: Line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper liners.
In a medium bowl, whisk together coconut flakes, sugar, and salt.
Add in melted butter and stir until well combined.
Press about 1 tablespoon of the coconut mixture into the bottom of each muffin cup.
Bake for 10 minutes, or until lightly golden.
In a blender or food processor, combine coconut cream, eggs, nutmeg, and sugar.
Pour the mixture evenly over the coconut crusts.
Bake for an additional 15-20 minutes, or until the filling is set and the edges are lightly golden.
Let cool completely in the pan before refrigerating or freezing for meal prep.
Serve chilled, garnished with toasted coconut flakes and a sprinkle of nutmeg.
notes: These tarts freeze well for up to 3 months.
